description: List or search Argentina's 24 provinces (incl. Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires) by name. Returns id, name, and centroid coordinates for each. Data: apis.datos.gob.ar/georef (INDEC), no auth required.

max.description: Maximum number of provinces to return (1-50, default 10).

query.description: Filter provinces by name substring, case-insensitive (e.g. "buenos" for Buenos Aires). Omit to list all 24 provinces (incl. CABA).

name: indec-georef.admin.provinces

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: List Argentine Provinces
